subject.title: fix(cron): do not set delivery mode to announce when disabling best-effort on payload edits

question: Should this PR intentionally stop `--no-best-effort-deliver` plus payload edits from forcing `delivery.mode="announce"`?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and correct, but it changes behavior for any existing automation that used the false flag plus payload edits as an implicit announce-mode update.

options.title: Accept the semantic fix
options.body: Land the PR with the current tests and proof, accepting that the false flag no longer implies announce mode.

options.title: Require old compatibility
options.body: Ask for a different patch that preserves the previous implicit announce behavior unless a new explicit opt-out is used.

options.title: Pause for cron owner
options.body: Hold the PR until a cron delivery owner decides whether this compatibility break is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Accept the semantic fix
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the current tests and proof, accepting that the false flag no longer implies announce mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR is assigned to @steipete, and the remaining question is a maintainer merge-risk decision rather than a code repair.
